name: Waveshare RP2040-Zero
description: Tiny RP2040 board (23.5 × 18 mm, USB-C) at 3.3 V logic with 20 GPIOs on castellated edges (GP0-GP15, GP26-GP29) and a WS2812 RGB LED on GP16. Runs real arduino-pico firmware on rp2040js. Pin ids are the GPIO numbers (GP0…GP29). 3.3 V only. Power: USB-C (jumper.json power.usb, default plugged in), or 3.5 to 5.5 V into the 5V pin (a 1S LiPo through a charger, a switch and a Schottky diode). No BAT pin, no charger on board.

pins.label: 5V
pins.description: Silkscreen 5V: VBUS. With USB plugged (power.usb, the default) the cable puts 5 V here; use it for 5 V parts, never on a GPIO. Without USB it is the board's power input (3.5 to 5.5 V into the on-board 3.3 V LDO): a LiPo goes here through a Schottky diode (stripe towards this pin) so USB never back-feeds the cell.

pins.label: GND
pins.description: Ground (all GND pins are one node).

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board LDO (about 0.25 V dropout): 3.3 V while the input is above about 3.55 V, then it follows the input down. Keep the load modest (Jumper checks against 300 mA).

pins.label: GP29
pins.description: RP2040 GPIO29; McuBackend pin "GP29" (pinMode(29, …) in arduino-pico). 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Functions: SIO, PWM6B, SPI1 CSn, UART0 RX, I2C0 SCL, PIO, ADC3.

pins.label: GP28
